source.title: Installing ty
source.description: Running via uvx, uv dev dependency or tool, standalone script, pip/pipx, mise, Docker, Bazel; upgrading and pinning versions; shell autocompletion.

source.title: Type checking
source.description: Running `ty check` on files or paths, how it finds your virtualenv and installed packages, `--python`, and `--watch` incremental rechecking.

source.title: Editor integration
source.description: Setting up ty's language server in VS Code, Neovim, Zed, PyCharm, Emacs or any LSP editor; keeping Pylance or basedpyright alongside it.

source.title: Configuration
source.description: Where ty finds pyproject.toml [tool.ty] or ty.toml, user-level config location, precedence when both exist, and how project, user and CLI settings merge

source.title: Module discovery
source.description: Fixing unresolved imports: first-party search paths (src layouts, environment.root), virtualenv/Conda/.venv detection order, --python, and PYTHONPATH handling

source.title: Python version
source.description: How the target version is inferred (requires-python, venv, 3.14 fallback), sys.version_info guards, version-dependent errors, and limited 3.7–3.9 support

source.title: Excluding files
source.description: src.include/exclude glob patterns, re-including default-excluded dirs with `!`, .gitignore handling, explicit CLI paths overriding excludes, and stray virtualenv diagnostics.

source.title: Rules
source.description: Setting rule levels (error, warn, ignore) via --error/--warn/--ignore flags or the [rules] config table, per rule or `all`, plus exit codes on warnings.

source.title: Suppression
source.description: Silencing errors inline or file-wide with `# ty: ignore[rule]` or `type: ignore`, multi-line and multi-tool comments, unused-ignore reporting, and @no_type_check.

source.title: Type system
source.description: Redeclaring variables with new types, intersection types and isinstance/hasattr narrowing, ty_extensions Intersection, top materializations, type-based unreachable branches for multi-version dependencies

source.title: Diagnostics
source.description: What ty error messages show: source snippets, related definitions, typo fix suggestions, and why a module is unavailable for your Python version

source.title: Language server
source.description: IDE features: navigation, auto-import completions, quick fixes, rename, inlay hints, Jupyter notebooks, supported/unsupported LSP methods table, no formatting (use Ruff)

source.title: Configuration
source.description: Every ty.toml/[tool.ty] option with defaults: rule severities, per-file overrides, silencing unresolved imports, return-type inference, strict narrowing, environment paths and Python version, output format.

source.title: Typing FAQ
source.description: Unknown, @Todo, Divergent and float* types; list invariance errors; Callable __name__ errors; unresolved imports; strict mode; missing-annotation warnings; monorepos; PEP 723 scripts; pre-commit; plugins.

source.title: Rules
source.description: Large searchable reference of every diagnostic rule: default severity, what triggers it, examples and fixes; includes opt-in strict rules like unsound-assignment, disjoint-cast, missing-override-decorator.

source.title: CLI Reference
source.description: Every ty subcommand and flag: rule severity overrides, exit-code control, CI output formats, watch mode, --fix, --add-ignore, Python environment and version selection.

source.title: Exit codes
source.description: What exit codes 0, 1, 2 and 101 mean, and flags making warnings fail or pass CI: --exit-zero, --error-on-warning, --exit-zero-on-warning.

source.title: Environment variables
source.description: TY_* variables for config file, log level, flamegraph profiling, parallelism and output format, plus how VIRTUAL_ENV, Conda, PYTHONPATH and XDG_CONFIG_HOME are read.

source.title: Editor settings
source.description: Language server options for VS Code and Neovim: diagnostic scope, inlay hints, auto-import completions, disabling language services, executable path, logging, uv integration.
